section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study that examined the factor structure of the BAS-2 in a university sample in Hong Kong and conducted preliminary construct-validity tests. The authors report examining associations between body appreciation and BMI (women and men), actual-ideal weight discrepancy (women), and self-esteem and life satisfaction (women and men), hypothesizing negative associations with weight discrepancy and positive associations with self-esteem and life satisfaction.
